newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht falls sharply against dlr after float.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht falls sharply against dlr after float.

text.p: The Thai baht fell sharply to a bid/offer range of 27.50/28.50 to the dollar shortly after the Bank of Thailand announced it let the currency float from Wednesday.
The baht later recovered to hover at about 27.300, traders said.
Currency dealers said the sharply lower baht rate compared with 25.80/25.90 late on Monday in domestic dealing and 24.80/25.10 in the offshore market.
